Thanks again for the signature; attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation timeline, canary migration windows, and the evaluation plan we discussed. Key asks from our side are highlighted below so we can lock dates this week: 

- Canary window: prefer 6/14–6/18 (3rd week cadence) — we need your ops team to confirm a 2-hour maintenance slot on one of those days.
- Migration cutover: target 7/10 evening (low traffic) with rollback gate at +24h.
- Training: two half-day workshops (eng + ops) week of 6/22.
- Eval plan: we propose a 7-day validation runway after canary with the attached Eval Checklist (pass/fail gates).

Attachments in this thread: Calyx-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Calyx-Eval-Checklist.pdf, Draft_SOW_Calyx.docx.

Could you please: (1) confirm the canary slot availability, (2) nominate primary and backup contacts for migration day, and (3) flag any procurement constraints that might change the timeline? Once we have those, we’ll circulate a locked calendar and assign runbook owners.

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync if that’s easier.

Thanks,
